name: apogee
description: Apogee — a Liquid Network wallet for your browser.

scripts.prebuild: if ls .env .env.local .env.production .env.production.local 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo 'refusing to build: a .env file is present (credentials could ship in the bundle) — remove it or use the CI release build' >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.playground.json
scripts.zip: if ls .env .env.local .env.production .env.production.local 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo 'refusing to zip: a .env file is present (credentials could ship in the bundle) — remove it or use the CI release zip' >&2; exit 1; fi && mkdir -p releases && rm -f releases/apogee-$npm_package_version.zip releases/apogee-$npm_package_version-chrome.zip releases/apogee-$npm_package_version-firefox.zip && vite build && (cd dist && zip -rX ../releases/apogee-$npm_package_version-chrome.zip . -x '*.DS_Store') && node scripts/build-firefox.ts && (cd dist-firefox && zip -rX ../releases/apogee-$npm_package_version-firefox.zip . -x '*.DS_Store')
